title: Register creators in a factory map
description: VehicleFactory creates vehicles via a switch statement keyed on a type string. Each supported vehicle type is a separate case, and the factory must be edited whenever a new type is introduced.
hints: Store creators in a Map<String, Supplier<Vehicle>> and look them up by type
Add a register(String type, Supplier<Vehicle> creator) method to allow new types
Throw an IllegalArgumentException when the type is not registered
issues: The factory uses a growing switch statement that must be edited for every new type
Adding a vehicle type requires changing the factory itself rather than just registering one
goals: Replace the switch with a Map of registered creator functions
New vehicle types can be added by calling register() without touching the factory
Unknown types throw a clear exception
